title: ROI images and statistics
description: dev's ROI classifier images and statistics (computeRoiImages, imageprops, dffprops), shown and sorted by in the viewer's ROI gallery. Around each ROI a box is cut from three images: the mean of the frames weighted by the ROI's ΔF/F, the mean of the frames of its top 1% ΔF/F (at least 50), both less the box's mean, and the local correlation image. The statistics are the peak ΔF/F, the salience of the ROI in its top 1% image, and how alike each ROI's weighted-mean and correlation images are to their mean over the ROIs (dev's templateSimilarity).

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the stack the ROIs were found in.

signals.title: ΔF/F
signals.description: Variable that holds the ROIs' ΔF/F (frames x ROIs), as compute_dff saves it.

boxSize.title: Box size
boxSize.description: Width and height of each ROI's images, in pixels (an even size is made odd).

output.title: Output
output.description: Variable the images and statistics are saved to.

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Of a stack with channels: the one to use, from 1

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a stack with planes: the one to use, from 1
